items.title: 9.15 Electromotive force (emf) aur potential difference (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.15 with Figs. 9.24 to 9.26 and Example 9.9 (PDF 213-215).

blocks.text: Electrical energy ka source, maslan cell ya battery, resistance se jorne par us mein mustaqil current qaim rakhta hai (Fig. 9.24). Cell musalsal energy deta hai jo circuit ki resistance mein zaya hoti hai. Maan lein mustaqil current qaim hone par waqt t mein circuit ke kisi cross-section se charge Q guzarta hai. Apni harkat ke doran yeh charge cell mein us ke kam potential wale sire se dakhil hota aur zyada potential wale sire se nikalta hai; source ko musbat charge ko zyada potential wale nuqte tak jane par majboor karne ke liye energy W deni parti hai.

blocks.title: Electromotive force
blocks.text: Source ka emf E woh energy hai jo cell unit charge ko deta hai: E = W/Q ... (9.41).

Electromotive force koi force nahi, aur hum ise newtons mein nahi napte. emf ki unit joule/coulomb hai, jo volt (V) hai. Cell ki charge carriers ko di gayi energy cell ke andar chemical energy ke electrical energy mein badalne se aati hai.

Circuit ke doosre hisson ki tarah cell bhi kuch resistance deta hai. Yeh resistance cell ke do electrodes ke darmiyan maujood electrolyte ki wajah se hai aur cell ki internal resistance kehlati hai. Yun internal resistance r wala emf E ka cell khalis emf E ke source ke barabar hai jis ke saath series mein resistance r ho (Fig. 9.25).

Emf E aur internal resistance r wala cell lein (Fig. 9.26). La-mehdood resistance wala voltmeter bairooni resistance R par potential difference napta hai, jo cell ke terminals par potential difference V hai. Circuit mein current I = E/(R + r), ya E = IR + Ir ... (9.42). Yahan IR = V current I ki maujoodgi mein cell ka terminal potential difference hai. Jab switch S khula ho to resistance se koi current nahi guzarta, aur voltmeter terminal voltage ke taur par emf E parhta hai. Yun current ki maujoodgi (switch on) mein terminal voltage emf E se Ir kam hota hai. Cell ke terminals par jura voltmeter (a) khule circuit par cell ka emf aur (b) band circuit par terminal potential difference napta hai (Do You Know).

Eq. 9.42 ko energy ke lihaz se samjhein: baen taraf emf E woh energy hai jo unit charge cell ke manfi se musbat terminal tak guzar kar hasil karta hai. Daen taraf batata hai ke current circuit se guzarte hue yeh energy kaise istemal hoti hai: unit charge ke guzarne par Ir ke barabar energy cell mein zaya hoti hai, aur baqi, potential drop IR, bairooni resistance R mein zaya hoti hai. Yun emf cell ki unit charge ko di gayi energy batata hai, aur mukhtalif hisson par potential drops is energy ke doosri shaklon mein zaya hone ka hisab dete hain. emf 'sabab' (cause) aur potential difference us ka 'asar' (effect) hai: emf hamesha maujood rehta hai chahe cell se current na liya jaye, magar conductor par potential difference sifar hai jab us mein current na behe.

blocks.title: Example 9.9
blocks.text: Khule circuit mein battery ke terminals ka potential difference 2.2 V hai. 5.0 ohm resistance se jorne par potential gir kar 1.8 V ho jata hai. Current aur battery ki internal resistance nikalein. Hal: E = 2.2 V, R = 5.0 ohm, V = 1.8 V. I = V/R = 1.8 V/5.0 ohm = 0.36 A. E = V + Ir: 2.2 V = 1.8 V + 0.36 A x r, to r = 1.1 V A^-1 = 1.1 ohm.

blocks.caption: Emf aur terminal potential difference
rows: source ki unit charge ko di gayi energy
bairooni circuit mein unit charge ki istemal ki energy
V = E - Ir, E se kam

blocks.prompt: Battery se liya gaya current barhane par us ka terminal potential difference kyun ghatta hai (constructed response 9.6)? 0.2 ohm internal resistance wali 12 V battery 3.6 ohm resistor se jori hai; terminal voltage nikalein (numerical 9.10).
blocks.explanation: V = E - Ir: internal resistance par girawat Ir current ke saath barhti hai, to terminals par emf ka kam hissa bachta hai. I = E/(R + r) = 12/3.8 = 3.16 A, aur V = IR = 3.16 x 3.6 = 11.4 V.

items: Emf E = W/Q (9.41): source ki fi unit charge di gayi energy, volts mein; cell mein chemical energy se. Electrolyte ki internal resistance r: I = E/(R + r), E = IR + Ir (9.42); terminal voltage V = E - Ir; khule circuit par V = E.
Emf sabab, potential difference asar. Example 9.9: I = 0.36 A, r = 1.1 ohm.
